async def act(page):
    # Step 1: Open the author filter dropdown
    author_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Author")
    await author_button.click()
    await page.wait_for_timeout(1000)  # Wait for dropdown to open
    
    # Step 2: Input 'Kilian' into the author filter
    # Look for a textbox within the dropdown; assume it has role 'textbox' and name containing 'author'
    author_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Filter by author")
    if await author_input.count() > 0:
        await author_input.fill("Kilian")
        await page.wait_for_timeout(500)
        # Apply the filter by pressing Enter or clicking a button
        apply_button = page.get_by_role("button", name="Search", exact=True).or_(page.get_by_role("button", name="Apply", exact=True))
        if await apply_button.count() > 0:
            await apply_button.click()
        else:
            await author_input.press("Enter")
    else:
        # If no author input found, try to filter via the searchbox
        searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search by message")
        await searchbox.fill("author:Kilian")
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 3: Filter by date 3/5/2023
    # Check if there's a date filter input; if not, use the searchbox for date
    date_input = page.get_by_role("textbox", name="Filter by date")
    if await date_input.count() > 0:
        await date_input.fill("2023-03-05")
        await date_input.press("Enter")
    else:
        # Use the searchbox to add date filter
        searchbox = page.get_by_role("searchbox", name="Search by message")
        await searchbox.fill("date:2023-03-05")
        await searchbox.press("Enter")
    await page.wait_for_load_state("networkidle")
    
    # Step 4: Count the commits
    # Commits are represented as links under main with commit messages
    # Get all links under main and filter to those that are likely commit messages
    main_section = page.get_by_role("main")
    commit_links = main_section.get_by_role("link").filter(has_text=lambda text: text and len(text) > 0)  # Filter non-empty links
    count = await commit_links.count()
    
    # Return the count as a string
    return str(count)
